meta.name: MCP Integration
meta.description: View Poi fleet, equipment, resource, quest, and other data from external tools through MCP.

port.label: Port
port.description: HTTP/MCP service listening port. Usually no change is needed.

service.label: Service
service.description: Starts or stops the MCP service.

input.label: WebView input
input.description: Sends input to the game screen. It is not needed for read-only use.

recording.label: Record play
recording.description: Records operations, screenshots, and related responses. It does not replay input.
recording.armed: Armed - starts on game mouse activity

debugEval.label: Debug eval
debugEval.description: For diagnostics. It can run arbitrary JavaScript, so leave it off for normal use.
debugEval.enabled: DANGEROUS: authenticated arbitrary code can run in the game WebView

status.loading: Waiting for Poi to load plugins

akashicRecords.name: Logbook (Akashic Records)
akashicRecords.description: Uses Logbook data in read-only mode.
